topic: Combine the outbound terms check with the enforcing guard at rebase
detail: SP-044 runs its check in orch-hook pre-tool-use on its own (branched from main before SP-041, PR #172, merged): it prints its own deny and the command log does not record the refusal as a decision. When the two meet: one deny path, the terms refusal recorded in the command log as refused with rule outbound_term or outbound_unchecked, the hook tests' TestMain (SP-041) covering the terms tests, and the terms check reading the terms layer switch from SP-041's snapshot instead of orch.db. SP-042's ProtectedPaths already refuses reads of terms files.
note: 2026-11-14: resolved in PR #177 (merge commit c6bccb1, verified at 190d97191df42f39b8706ff883225a12e39e2b1d): one deny path (writeDeny), terms refusals recorded through RecordToolEvent as enforced refusals with rule outbound_term or outbound_unchecked, the hook's terms tests under SP-041's TestMain, the terms layer switch read from the guard snapshot (GuardSnapshot.Terms), and replay carrying recorded terms verdicts (GuardEnforcement.Terms).
